description: `ui-health validate scenario <name> --json` emits ONE consolidated `Report` covering all check groups (static manifest, static UI-interop, static project-UI standards, bundle freshness, runtime/render, AI surface search, and auto-fix availability). Each `Finding` carries a stable `check_group`, `code`, `severity`, and `dimension`, and where applicable `fix_class` and `autofix_available`, so a single command surfaces the complete UI-health picture for a scenario.

requirements.description: The `Report` and `Finding` data model must carry a stable `check_group` field identifying which of the seven check groups produced each Finding, plus a `code`, `severity`, and `dimension`. Findings that originate from fixable checks must also carry `fix_class` and `autofix_available` fields.
requirements.title: Report and Finding carry check_group, fix_class, autofix_available

validation.notes: Each Finding serializes a non-empty check_group identifying its originating check group
Findings include stable code, severity, and dimension fields in JSON output
Findings from fixable checks carry fix_class and autofix_available; non-fixable Findings default fix_class to manual
Run `ui-health validate scenario <name> --json` and confirm every Finding in the output has a populated check_group field
Report schema is stable and versioned so test-genie and app-monitor can rely on check_group/fix_class/autofix_available

requirements.description: A single invocation of `ui-health validate scenario <name> --json` must produce one Report in which all seven check groups (static manifest, static UI-interop, static project-UI standards, bundle freshness, runtime/render, AI surface search, auto-fix availability) are representable. No check group requires a separate command.
requirements.title: All seven check groups representable in one report

validation.notes: The Report model enumerates all seven check_group values as valid
A single validate invocation populates Findings spanning multiple check groups for a scenario with mixed violations
Run `ui-health validate scenario <name> --json` once and confirm the consolidated Report includes results from static and dynamic groups without a second command
A single consolidated report is the canonical UI-health output and no check group is omitted when all are applicable

title: Single consolidated UI-validation report
